concept: CloudWatch Logs: Logs Insights and metric filters
tests: How to centrally analyze logs interactively and build alarms on log patterns.
expected: CloudWatch Logs + Logs Insights (interactive queries) + metric filters → metrics → alarms. Triggers: "query log data interactively", "metric-based alarms", "centralizes logs".
why_not: Logs only in S3 without analysis — no alerting; printing to console and emailing do not scale.
